speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing the cough and shortness of breath, and do you have any fever or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been going on for about a month, and the shortness of breath started recently when I try to walk up hills. I've checked myself, and I don't have a fever or night sweats at all. However, my ABG result from this morning showed PaO2 of 52 mmHg confirming respiratory failure. Please use this lab result as the confirmed evidence.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pulmonary Fibrosis (likely Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis given the subacute progressive dyspnea, dry cough, exertional limitation, lack of fever/night sweats, and significant hypoxemia on ABG).
